Today's hot fix addresses several gameplay, map, and localization issues. Many of the fixes and changes included in today’s update are thanks to your feedback. We will continue to monitor the multiplayer meta and matchmaking feedback in the coming days. Please report bugs or share your feedback on the help portal.
[p align="center"]
Fixed an exploit that allow Saboteurs to generate extra munitions when Munition Surplus was upgraded
Removed/fixed some duplicate weapon data that was causing desync issues
Fixed case where Jäger Squad was able to acquire both Recon Package and Panzerschreck upgrades
Fixed retreat points sometimes not working until toggled off and on when captured from enemy

We are continuing to make adjustments to matchmaking as the ELO Spread was not working as intended. It was possible to automatch with a second player with 1000+ ELO difference. We have enabled a maximum ELO difference and maximum ELO difference for party of 1000 across 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4 modes. We will continue to monitor these changes and make further adjustments as necessary
Fixed a rare condition which was causing an occasional crash when parachuting units are killed in the air
Fixed a crash that occurred when ending a match
Fixed several localization issues, including formatting
Rainy weather has been added to (4) Pisa Centrale, to ensure there is some foul weather present in the 2vs2 Quickmatch map pool
Added new audio events to (4) Pisa Centrale, to ensure rain sound effects (SFX) trigger on launch, rain SFX changes as the rain declines, and turns off when the rain ends

Reconnected multiplayer data from the old version of Rapido River Crossing to the new version. While the new version was appearing correctly in Quick match and other modes, it was failing to connect to the Map Preference system, which was pointed towards the old version of the map
Red, placeholder measurement lines on Qattara Depression have been removed
Adjusted combat slots for a factory building found in Ancona Railyard and North Africa maps to enable more units to fire from the rooftop

The team at Relic is constantly reviewing issues reported by the community and adjusting priorities to address the most frequently occurring issues. Thank you for all your submissions to help.relic.com. To see a comprehensive list of the issues we are currently tracking, please refer to the 3.0.0 Update Patch Notes.

The Company of Heroes 3: 3.0 Update arrives as part of the 20th Anniversary celebrations for the Company of Heroes franchise. Our biggest update to Company of Heroes 3 since launch, 3.0 delivers major improvements across the core game experience, including environments and visuals, effects, audio, A.I., gameplay, maps, campaigns, balance, and more.

New weather effects, seasonal environments, lighting and visual improvements bring greater variety and atmosphere to the battlefield, while a collection of new and refreshed maps, campaign improvements, and quality-of-life updates further refine the Company of Heroes 3 experience.
Update 3.0 introduces a substantial visual and environmental overhaul across Company of Heroes 3, bringing greater variety, atmosphere, and battlefield readability to maps throughout the game.
New winter, autumn and industrial environments
Snow and rain weather effects
Dynamic terrain wetness, transitioning between dry and wet conditions
Enhanced soldier lighting for improved readability
Improved atmospheric fog, smoke, and environmental effects
Improved bloom and emissive effects
Additional map and environmental visual improvements
The sights and sounds of the battlefield are also receiving a significant update in 3.0, with improvements to combat audio and visual effects alongside an expanded selection of music.
Improved weapon firing sounds
Enhanced impact and explosion audio
Improved vehicle destruction audio
Expanded music selection featuring classic tracks from Company of Heroes and Company of Heroes 2

Final Stand is receiving a large content update that focuses on improving replayability. We are adding co-op for up to 3-players, a new Battleground, additional unit unlocks, new passive technologies, and new ability unlocks.
In 3-player co-op, enemy events will scale up in magnitude based on player count.
There will be buffs for players and a few new tricks for the enemy.
Update 3.0 brings a collection of new and refreshed maps to Company of Heroes 3, alongside broader improvements to map visuals and environments.

To complement the new winter and autumn environments, we are introducing a new Ultimate Set of cosmetics which will be available to purchase tomorrow with the release of the 3.0 Anniversary Update:
US Forces – Climb to Glory
Wehrmacht – Edelweiss
British Forces – Bloody Baltic
Deutsches Afrikakorps – Cold Snap
Victory Point – Industrial
Update 3.0 includes a wide-ranging pass on the Company of Heroes 3 campaign experience, addressing longstanding issues while improving campaign presentation, clarity, and gameplay.

New clear neutral lighting for better readability - improved readability on the Campaign map by reducing the noise of unimportant items such as farmland, railroad tracks and road variations, and increasing the contrast and readability of important landmarks such as cities, hospitals, ports, etc.
Revisited lighting, dressing and atmosphere on all Campaign missions to modify the tone to be more dramatic and to make it more varied and authentic than before
Certain costlier sections of the Campaign map have been optimized

In Update 3.0, we are improving team games with a focus on making tactics and positioning more important throughout Company of Heroes 3. You can find the full list of changes in the incoming patch notes, but for a quick overview:
Multiplayer has undergone targeted changes to improve the feel of larger team games
Major Economy Rework
Rebalance of Artillery
Reduction of massing vehicles
Stronger Emphasis on Positioning
Reworked an existing Battlegroup and made several small adjustments to others
Improved A.I logic for Combat Assessment
U.I Elements tidied up to convey critical gameplay information
Improved how possible matches are evaluated in multiplayer modes during matchmaking

The biggest change will be the way the A.I. calculates unit strength so it can judge fights more realistically and make better decisions when assessing what to build in what order. We will cover these in more depth in the patch notes.

Update 3.0 will also introduce a substantial balance pass, with changes across factions, units, abilities, and the wider multiplayer experience. For a full list of all incoming balance changes, be sure to check out our patch notes.
Tune in to our fireside chat on November 5th on our Company of Heroes Twitch channel for more.
From the Rangers, to the Whizbang, to the Bersaglieri, our incoming global balance changes range across multiple units and systems to improve the general multiplayer experience.
Overall game pacing, economy, and resources
US Forces getting changes to allow combat variants to always be accessible and Assault Engineers being reworked to be a separate unit
Increasing the versatility of late game Wehrmacht
A change to the British Forces Infantry Training Center
A major change to Operation Skorpion
You can learn from our team about the work that went into the 3.0 Update with our Dev Diaries.

Fixed an exploit that brought Final Stand perks into multiplayer matches

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40883127/452a9d6072db2543003f6ddfffef2c0157078f5c.jpg"]Today's Hot Fix primarily fixes an exploit with artillery units and adds logging to help us identify and troubleshoot fixes for crashes.
Fixed an issue that allowed certain artillery units to barrage consistently without a cooldown
If players still discover rare instances of this occurring after this hot fix, please report it at https://help.relic.com/ with reproduction steps
Added additional logging to identify fixes for crashes
Updating from 2.5.3 to 2.5.5 due to cross platform compatibility constraints
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40883127/58acbab57a32c6bef1f1307289a7fa7ade4b527b.jpg"]
Fixed an issue where perk points would sometimes not be saved when exiting the game immediately after a Final Stand match
Fixed perks not always saving immediately on closing the perks screen
Fixed Final Stand matches appearing in the Observable Games browser; they can't be observed
Final Stand Gameplay
Fixed a bug where certain enemy vehicles would not move along their assigned waypoint path in Final Stand such as the Wespe boss unit
Fixed Afrikakorps vehicle attack speed perk being reapplied after upgrading a vehicle
Fixed Afrikakorps vehicle attack speed perk to correctly increase rate of fire instead of decreasing it
Fixed Critical Location ability to only be usable on emplacements/bunkers
Fixed Critical Location not being able to be used on some emplacements
General Gameplay
Suppression vehicles and team weapons now move into the interactive zone before entering combat
Fixed edge cases around team weapon A.I. occasionally issuing move commands past units before setting up
Stability/Performance
Added additional Microsoft Visual Studio .dlls to prevent a rare crash on startup with misconfigured systems
Fixed an occasional crash when viewing Battlegroups in the lobby
Fixed a crash when updating Battlegroup selections
Added additional logging for gameplay related crashes/bugsplats
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46192591/6d0f09c4b94275982eb95298a5e01b6d12ebf490.jpg"]
Final Stand Perk save data now shares/uploads to Steam Cloud saves. Players should now be able to change computers and have their Final Stand data transfer with them
For base Company of Heroes 3 owners, mods applied in other game modes will no longer affect the Final Stand game
Removed a hole in the soft map edge on Qattara Depression - this was causing enemy units to "enter" the playable area and become trapped in an out-of-bounds region
Fixed several crashes around A.I. behavior and missing null pointers
Heavy Machine Guns controlled by the A.I. in Final Stand will now prioritize infantry over the lane emplacements
Fixed an issue with the A.I. idling Kettenkrads on the map
A.I. armored vehicles will no longer fallback or issue move commands when attacked by non-vehicles on first contact
Fixed the Demolish Charge and M6 Anti-Tank mines not being unlocked for the US Forces Rifleman, Engineer, and Bazooka squads after upgrading Demolitions Package from the Infantry Support Centre
Fixed a tinting issue causing US Paratrooper HMG team helmets to appear as a default grey/white texture

Enemy bosses may get stuck in the out-of-bounds area of a Battleground. This is more common with long-range artillery bosses such as the Wespe. This will require additional work to adjust A.I. logic and will need more rigorous testing from our team before implementing a fix. While we work to address this, as a workaround we recommend withdrawing your units closer to your HQ to force the enemy to move in-bounds to reach its maximum weapon range.
Today's hot fix introduces a new lobby system for Co-Op mode in Final Stand so that players can easily find matches with others and customize their experience.
Final Stand
When selecting "Co-Op" in Final Stand, players will now be presented with a Browse Games lobby list
Players will be able to search for an open lobby and view selected maps and difficulty levels
Players will also be able to create their own game with their preferred options from this menu
Players can set lobbies to private or public
Added several translations for in-game strings/text that were only displaying in English

Update 2.5.0 will be available for Company of Heroes 3 today at 10am PT and includes 2 new maps, a refresh of the game lobby, and several changes to gameplay systems and multiplayer balance. Much of the multiplayer balance work in today's update is a first major step towards addressing the current meta of massing units (blobbing). This work begins today with a focus on infantry, and will continue in the next major update, 3.0 in October, with more changes targeting the massing of vehicles. Today's update also supports the release of Company of Heroes 3's first standalone experience – Final Stand. Many of the fixes and changes included in today’s update are thanks to your feedback. Please continue to share your feedback or ask the dev team questions here and report any issues to us at help.relic.com.

Company of Heroes 3: Final Stand introduces an all-new standalone wave defense experience designed for solo and co-op play. Build layered defenses, hold the line against overwhelming odds, and survive 12 increasingly challenging waves of enemy forces featuring dynamic battlefield events and powerful bosses. Battle across multiple Battlegrounds against forces drawn from the Wehrmacht, US Forces, British Forces, and Deutsches Afrikakorps factions. Learn more about Final Stand here and buy it now for a 10% discount during the launch period and a bonus 20% discount for Company of Heroes 3 owners.

notes.title: New Maps added to all modes

items.text: Butcher & Bolt - (1vs1)

Night-time desert raids are synonymous with the exploits of British Commandos. Relive their daring exploits in our new 1vs1 map! Players will always be close to their enemy's HQ, but resources on the extreme flanks are what will secure victory – overextend at your own risk, and strike fast to sever any opponent who does not watch their back.
Raids conducted by the Special Air Service and Long Range Desert Group (affectionately known as the Desert Taxi Service) marked a turning point in the desert war.

While the siege of Tobruk ground on during the winter of 1941, convoys of British Commandos struck out at airfields and munitions depots from the inhospitable Great Sand Sea, melting away into the night once the deed was done. Such raids destroyed German and Italian planes on the ground, starved fighting vehicles of fuel, and rid soldiers of their munitions.
Casualties among the Commandos were high, but their long-term effect on enemy morale endured for the remainder of the war.
Across the Savio - (3vs3)

Community map makers DutchToast and Foolish Viceroy have again restored a beloved Company of Heroes classic – Across the Rhine. This is a map of tiers, with players fighting for control over the boggy lowlands at the river’s edge, the concrete battlements to the center, or the farmlands on the high ground. We hope players enjoy returning to an iconic battlefield first introduced in Company of Heroes 2’s British Forces DLC.

On October 21, 1944, the Savio River was hastily formed into the next brutal line of defense. German forces had fallen back through a series of river positions, from the Foglia to the Lamone, but at the Savio, progress halted. With continuing rainfall and floodwaters threatening to collapse its banks, the Savio proved to be one of the most deadly bridgeheads faced by the Allies in Italy.

We are still collecting feedback from our Official Discord and making changes where we felt they were most needed. Thanks again to our dedicated community for all feedback provided; please do not hesitate to leave any further feedback or issues on our maps.
White Barracks building now has correct death states. If it collapses into an impassible ruin, it should block movement and sight
Large fuel tanks have been given shot blocking properties, which persist until they are destroyed.
(8) Oliveto Citra - more blockers have been added around the central bunker building, reducing the risk that vehicles can shoot through it at specific angles
(2 & 4) Djebel Pass - Barbed wire has been adjusted near a stone wall that appears usable for cover, but was blocked
(4) Pisa Centrale - Players were driving over explosive red barrels and did not expect them to explode. Explosive red barrels have been removed. This is why we can't have nice things
(8) Alam el Halfa - HQ bunkers have been redesignated to the correct players. Each player's HQ should now be protected by their own bunker/HMG nest

(8) Castello della Nebbia - Players had raised complaints that the Eastern cutoff was too easy to pin down as the attacker. The Eastern cutoff has been redesigned. A small land bridge has been removed to open movement around this area, a building has also been removed to improve sight and firing lines, and cover has been added to this area to aid the defender
Lobby & Battlegroup Selection Improvements
We've overhauled the multiplayer lobby experience to streamline Battlegroup selection and to improve usability across Skirmish, Co-op vs A.I., Quick Match, and Custom Games.

Battlegroups can now be selected directly from a dropdown menu without leaving the lobby screen. Players who prefer the previous experience can still access full Battlegroup tech trees through the new More Info option
A.I. Player Battlegroup options can be restricted by assigning empty Battlegroup slots, forcing the A.I. to select a specific Battlegroup, allowing for more control over your experience

Sub-selecting units from a garrison or multiple-selection (especially when using the Tab key to cycle the sub-selection) now displays decorators for garrisoning and sub-selected units in the correct state. This will make it easier to distinguish which unit you are focusing on when multi-selecting/commanding
For multiplayer balance in update 2.5.0, we are aiming to improve the importance of unit tactics and micro, and big changes are coming to some core systems.

Our main target this update is to make infantry positioning more rewarding. Cover is more durable and harder to crush, targeting and suppression is much more punishing against infantry in the open, and multiple weapons are being made weaker against cover.

We hope these changes make a difference to the early phases of the game, but we do not expect them to fix all of the frustrations players have right now. Mass vehicle play is a problem we’re aware of, and we will be looking at that more closely in update 3.0.0 in October. These changes take a great deal of time to test and validate, especially since there are always uneven winners and losers when making global changes. So we will closely monitor this update and your feedback.
Pathing
We've made several improvements to pathing, fixing some longstanding issues.
Vehicles that are already reversing no longer overly favor reversing when a new move order is given in front of them
Smoother rapid movement commands - issuing movement orders in quick succession should no longer cause slowdowns or jitter
Smarter navigation around obstacles - vehicles now make better decisions when turning near or around movement blockers
Infantry Combat and Suppression

We are making some changes to infantry combat to help alleviate some of the issues facing the game. These changes are not meant to fix all the issues regarding massed infantry, but they should make it easier for the defender to reduce the effectiveness of the enemy when fighting from good positions or are backed by suppression.
Infantry Formations

We are tightening infantry squad formations to make squads that are in the open slightly more vulnerable to area of effect weapons as squads currently have wide formations and reduce the amount of space a squad covers.
Direction and position of the squad is now always determined by a model at the front of the squad, rather than the back/center
Most squads have had their formation tightened by 0.5 - 1 in-game meters
Infantry Small-Arms Priority

Infantry weapon priority has been adjusted to make combat more consistent and reduce cases where infantry squads spread their damage amongst all members of the enemy squad. This should make it easier to bleed enemy models over the course of an engagement.

Infantry squad members will now prefer to focus on the closest enemy squad member directly in front of them when they engage infantry. This generally means most weapons will target the front models of the squad
This tends to allow squads in cover to focus down squad members faster while damage tends to be more spread out against the defender when they are being directly attacked from the front or back
Infantry rifles no longer re-roll their target to pick the next best target in a targeted squad

Infantry small arms no longer take over-penetration into account when firing on enemies; this previously resulted in weapons like Light Machine Guns(LMGs), Scoped Rifles, and Automatic Rifles to target enemy squad members in the rear of the formation

These changes generally make squads in cover have damage distributed more evenly amongst its members while squads in the open are more likely to have a single model focused down depending on the angle of engagement
Suppression

The following changes make it significantly harder for suppressed enemies to break suppression while they are still in-combat. Previously, only a weapon that dealt suppression damage could keep a squad in the suppressed state with enemies automatically recovering even if they were in combat after 10 seconds.
This should make it easier to halt large masses of infantry so long as the Heavy Machine Gun (HMG) can get its suppression off, and nearby units are able to prevent suppression recovery.
Out of Combat suppression recovery bonus now only applies if the squad is not being fired on; before this would only trigger if the squad was fired on by a weapon with suppression
Squads will still gain their out of combat bonus to suppression recovery if they are firing but not being fired at after 10 seconds
Heavy Machine Guns

We are increasing the penetration power of HMGs to allow them to better combat early ultra-light vehicles to allow for more soft counters which should be able to help factions like the Wehrmacht in team games where they lack their own combat capable ultra-light unit.
The power of the HMG is being reduced against units in cover as the changes to suppression make these units significantly stronger in infantry combat.
Axis HMG penetration increased from 1.3/1.2/1.1 to 2.25/1.75/1.6
Allied HMG penetration increased from 1.6/1.4/1.2 to 2.5/2.25/1.75
50cal HMG damage modifier against light vehicles increased from 0.25 to 0.35
HMG accuracy against units in cover reduced from 50% to 60%
Automatic Rifles and Light Machine Guns

Special weapons like automatic rifles and LMGs are having their damage penalties against heavy and garrison cover types increased to match most weapons. This will make heavy cover more valuable against the majority of upgraded squads in the game.
Damage penalty against heavy and garrison cover increased from 40% to 50%
Team Weapons
Team weapons will no longer be counted to the area of effect damage limit, making damage against them more predictable with units like mortars or artillery.
The weapon no longer counts towards the damage limit against area of effect weapons
Munition Points

As fuel plays such an important factor for gaining tech-based power spikes, the capture time of certain munition points are being reduced to make it easier for players to prioritize this resource in the early game.
Capture speeds sped up from 45 to 30 for +16 munitions points
Capture speed sped up from 15 seconds to 12.5 for +5 munition points
Mortars and Mortar Halftracks

Mortars are receiving adjustments to make them a little easier to access but have slightly slower speeds. We have also increased their penetration against certain objects to make them better able to destroy cover or abandoned team weapons.
Mortar manpower cost reduced from 260 to 240
250 mortar upgrade cost reduced from 75 to 60
Mortar High Explosive barrage cooldown increased from 0.5 to 0.625
Now has +200% weapon penetration against sandbags
Now has +200% weapon penetration against team weapons
Light Artillery - Pack Howitzer, 4.2 Inch Heavy Mortar, le.IG 18 Support Gun

Light artillery is too effective against stationary targets, having high damage payloads, good range, and good area of effect that makes it a little too hard to fight from cover when these units are on the field.

To retain their hitting power, while reducing their ability to take a squad out of a fight with a single hit, these units will be inaccurate at the start of their barrage, but steadily have their accuracy increase the more they fire.
Light Artillery angle scatter increased from 6 to 10
Light Artillery distance scatter max increased from 5 to 11.25
Light Artillery scatter ratio increased from 0.05 to 0.1125
Light Artillery barrages now gain +33% scatter accuracy each time the weapon fires
Medium Anti-Tank Guns - 6-pounder, 57mm, Pak 38/40
The power of veteran Anti-Tank (AT) guns is being slightly reduced as their rate of fire can be oppressive to medium tanks, and they level up very quickly.
Veterancy required per rank from 1000/3000/6000 to 1100/3300/6600
Veterancy Rank 3 rate of fire bonus decreased from 30% to 25%
Casualty Recovery
Recovered casualties could still provide too much manpower over the course of a long game. Because of this, we are further reducing the amount refunded to the player.
Manpower recovery from 25 to 20
Vehicle Weapons

We are slightly reducing the effectiveness of vehicles that fire on the move - mainly against infantry - by allowing projectiles to scatter further in front or behind the target when a miss is rolled.
The previous system always capped the distance scatter to the scatter max value even if the moving scatter penalties would bring it over the limit.
Direct-fire and autocannon vehicles standardized to 1.25 movement distance scatter max
Lobbed projectiles retain 1.5 movement distance scatter max
Makes these units generally more inaccurate if they get a shot off while moving; includes Stummel, Brummbar, Dozer and StuG D
Centaur and Scott are exceptions to this rule
Direct-Fire Ballistic Weapons - Autocannons, Anti-Aircraft Guns, Anti-Tank Rifles, Tank Cannons

Previously, cover would not provide its damage reduction bonus if a projectile-based weapon’s shell landed behind the unit’s cover or the weapon rolled a hit. This caused heavy cover to be somewhat ineffective against certain weapons.
We are making a change so all direct-fire based projectile weapons now have their damage properly reduced if the cover bonus would apply.
If a target would gain directional or area cover bonuses against a firing unit, cover damage reduction modifiers will now take affect for both direct hits, splash damage, and suppression damage
This does not affect things like mortars, light artillery, heavy artillery or units like the Stummel with a lobbed projectile
Cover

We are increasing the durability of many map objects in the game, particularly heavy cover objects so the battlefield retains strongpoints for longer periods of time, allowing for more dynamic infantry combat. Previously, it was too easy to destroy the majority of cover objects, which led maps to being fairly barren by the mid game.
Heavy cover map objects armor increased from 25 to 35
Heavy cover map objects have standardized health values
Large objects (pre-wrecked vehicles) have 600 health
Medium objects (pre-placed sandbag walls) have 300 health
Small objects (stone walls) have 300 health
Light cover map objects armor standardized to 25
Light cover map objects have two classes of health values
Decoration objects have below 200 health
Cover objects have a minimum of 200 health
Flattened building ruins now more consistently provide heavy cover to infantry and team weapons that enter them
Light Vehicles - Marders, Stuarts, Chaffee, Semovente, Carro, 8rad

The majority of light vehicles are having their medium crush reduced to light crush to increase the longevity of heavy cover in the early to mid-game. We have noticed that maps could be easily flattened, reducing the amount of positional play there was early game vehicles hit the field.
Crush type changed from medium to light
Wespe and Bishop Self-Propelled Artillery

Certain artillery units are having their veterancy adjusted to have their ability recharge bonuses lessened or moved to higher levels. Currently, veteran artillery units can have too much up-time, allowing for constant barrages that make positional play very difficult in the late game.
The Cannone, Whizbang, and Walking Stuka changes can be found in faction notes.
Veterancy bonuses for these two units changed to the following:
Veterancy 1: +25% rate of fire
Veterancy 2: +20% ability range, +20% scatter accuracy
Veterancy 3: +60 HP, +20% Ability Recharge speed, Unique bonus
High Explosive Light Artillery Barrage - Pack Howitzer, le.IG 18, Heavy Mortar, Stummel, Scott, M3 75mm HE Barrage
This change is to make these units less effective against vehicles which they are not intended to counter.
Deals 25% less damage against vehicles
Rifle Grenades

We are reducing the kill radius of the rifle grenade to make them less devastating. There will still be instances they can kill a squad, but this doesincrease the chance a healthy squad in a line formation or one that is dodging, will survive.
Area of effect distance lowered from 2 to 1.5
Team Weapon Formations

We are making a change that allows team weapons like HMGs to have further spacing when placed in cover to make it harder to destroy/damage the entire crew with a single grenade or area-of-effect (AOE) weapons.
On longer cover pieces that allow for it, the squads spacing has been increased to prevent the squad from stacking
Paradropping
Units paradropping can be targeted and killed
Satchel Charges no longer start on cooldown for paradropping units
Medical Vehicle Healing Auras - 251/M3, CWT, 2.5 Tonne Truck

The healing range of these mobile healing and reinforcement platforms has been reduced to make front-line healing more risky when dealing with indirect-fire/AOE weapons and force the truck to get closer to the frontline.
Healing range reduced from 20 to 15
Panzerschreck
The Panzerschreck is having its far aim-time reduced, allowing this weapon to engage long-range targets sooner.
Far aim-time sped up from 2 to 1.75
Flamethrowers
This change should reduce how likely a mine will trigger on contact with a flamethrower while still making these weapons able to quickly clear a mine if the player knows its location.
Removed bonus damage against mines
Off-Map Heavy Artillery Strikes

A large number of off-map artillery strikes are having their cooldowns increased to give more moments in the game where the player in not constantly under attack from off-maps, especially in team games.
End-game off-map recharge increased from 120 to 180 seconds
155mm Rapid Artillery Barrage
Railway Artillery
Carpet Bombing Run
240mm Black Dragon
Perimeter Monitor
Recon Artillery
Incendiary Bombing Run
Incendiary Carpet Bombing Run
Anti-Tank Rocket Loiter
Supercharged Creeping Barrage
Decapitation Strike
Dive Bomb
Anti-Tank Overwatch
Fragmentation Bombing Run
Zeroing Artillery
Nebelwerfer Overwatch
V1 Rocket Strike
Engineers, Pioneers, Sappers and Panzerpioneers
Gain +35% construction speed at Veterancy 2
Support Center Upgrades Locked Behind Tank Depot

We are locking a number of Support Center upgrades behind the Tank Depot to reduce the power of strategies that focused on getting powerful upgrades early and creating more incentives to reach the Tank Depot.
Survival Training
Double Sortie
Rapid Repairs
M1918 Browning Automatic Rifles

The BAR is once again being locked behind the Support Center to allow for more un-upgraded infantry play in the early game that is combined with lessening the impact of shock timings early game on other factions.
Locked behind Support Center
Research time sped up from 60 to 30
Bazooka Team
Steady Fire set-up time reduced from 7 to 5 seconds
Riflemen Squad
Sprint now costs 15 munitions
M1919 HMG Team
Build time sped up from 30 to 25 seconds
M1919A6 Light Machine Gun - All variants
The M1919A6 LMG is having its firepower slightly increased to bring it more in-line with other weapons.
Accuracy increased from 0.49/0.38/0.34 to 0.539/0.419/0.375
All variants standardized to the Paratrooper LMG - affects Captain and Ranger weapon crate drop. This is an increase in damage-per-second (DPS)
Sherman Whizbang
Veterancy 2 now provides the following: 20% rate of fire, 20% ability range
Veterancy 3 now provides the following: 15% recharge speed, 30% rate of fire, +6 additional rockets
Char B1 Heavy

The Char’s armor is being slightly reduced to make it more vulnerable to AT fire from the front, particularly when Mechanized Support Center (MSC) armor and veterancy bonuses come into play. Its fuel price has also been increased to better reflect its performance.
Front armor reduced from 320 to 300
Fuel cost increased from 100 to 110
Zone Rouge
Recharge time increased from 45 seconds to 120
Munition cost increased from 50 to 60
Advanced Tourelle
Now grants 480 health from 360
Command Point cost reduced from 3 to 2
SSF Commando Squad
SSF Knife throw deals 100% extra damage when thrown from camouflage/recently attacking from camo within 4 seconds
Knife throw range increased from 15 to 18
Paratrooper Squad
To better reflect their role as advanced infantry, we have slightly increased the DPS of the stock Paratrooper squad.
Carbine fire aim-time sped up from 0.375/0.625 to 0.25/0.5
Carbine cooldown sped up from 0.5/1 to 0.375/0.875
Gallant Stand
Received damage penalty reduced from 50% to 25%
Pershing
Veterancy 1 replaced with +25% weapon traverse speed
Speed increased from 5.3 to 5.5

Wehrmacht is receiving several small changes targeting their early game to give them a little more resilience by having slightly more manpower and combat effectiveness for their starting units while reducing the impact their shock timings provided by Officer Quarters and the faction’s light vehicles.
Infanterie Kompanie
Manpower cost reduced from 100 to 80
Infanterie Kompanie Officer Quarters
The fuel price and research time of Infanterie Kompanie is being raised to lessen the impact of the timing push Wehrmacht can do in the early game and give their opponent more time to respond.
Research time increased from 45 to 60
Fuel cost increased from 25 to 35
Pioneer Squad

Pioneers are having their firepower slightly increased to better allow them to support Grenadiers in the early game or when engaging units like Scouts. Build times have been increased to prevent how quickly Pioneers can grab map control by massing them.
Accuracy increased from 0.42/0.3/0.24 to 0.442/0.3/0.24
Weapon cooldown reduced from 2/2.5 to 1.75/2
Build time increased from 12 to 18
Grenadier Squad
Manpower cost reduced from 260 to 250
Accuracy increased from 0.75/0.656/0.6475 to 0.75/0.69/0.68
Sprint now costs 15 munitions
Jager Squad
Panzerschreck cost reduced from 90 to 80
Clearing Gear Rifle Grenade cost lowered from 40 to 35
Flak 30 Anti-Aircraft Gun Team
Crew health reduced from 105 to 100
221 Armored Car
The 221 is having its fuel cost increased and armor reduced to make it easier to soft counter by positioning/cover in the early game and slow down its rush timing.
Fuel cost increased from 30 to 35
Armor reduced from 20/15/10 to 12/12/10
Machine Gun penetration increased from 1/1/1 to 2/1.75/1.5
251 Halftrack and Variants
Front armor reduced from 12.5 to 9.5
Stummel can now fire on the move
Nebelwerfer 42 Rocket Launcher Team
Manpower cost reduced from 360 to 340
Fire aim time removed
Wind down and wind up changed from 0.3/1.45 to 0.375/1.375
Sturmpioneer Squad
Manpower cost from 210 to 200
Reinforce cost from 35 to 34
Fallschirmpioneer Squad
Health increased from 95 to 100
251/16 Flammpanzerwagen

Adjustments have been made to the 251/16 to reduce its impact on the battlefield by increasing its build time and experience requirements and reducing its health, which also comes with the reduced frontal armor change on the standard 251. We still want the 251/16 to be more durable than the standard 251 as the unit needs to get closer to the front, but the reduced armor and health should allow small-arms support to put the 251/16 at risk of being finished off by AT weapons.
No longer does bonus damage against infantry in garrisons
Build time increased from 30 to 45
Veterancy requirements increased from 900/2700/5400 to 1100/330/6600
Health reduced from 400 to 360
Borgward Wanze
Rocket angle scatter reduced from 25 to 17.5
Coastal Reserves Squad
Cost reduced from 260 to 250
Oto Incendiary Anti-tank grenade now gains +40 damage at Veterancy 2
Updated tool-tip to indicate the grenade can still also crew shock in addition to other effects
Jericho Trumpets
Radius coverage reduced from 50 to 45
Siege Camp and Pantherturm
Officer Quarters from Luftwaffe and Panzergrenadier Kompanie provides bonuses to these structures
Siege Camp
Recharge and attack speed bonus lowered from 25% to 15%
Command Panzer IV Medium Tank
Now competes against the Blitzkrieg ability as a tier 2 pick. Tiger is standalone
Requires either Support Elements or Panzer Kompanie to be called in
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40883127/aadd54ebce09840d91744326eed0bd5733197f21.png"]
Infantry Training
The amount of experience being granted by Infantry Training has been reduced as units would start reaching Veterancy 2 too quickly after this upgrade was researched.
Experience gain reduced from 800 to 600
Team Weapon Training
Team Weapon Training is having its cost increased to better reflect the strong benefits it gives to team weapons.
Cost increased from 150 manpower and 25 fuel to 200 manpower and 30 fuel
Light Vehicle Training
The ability recharge speed of this upgrade is being reduced primarily to target the Bishop’s recharge speed which resulted in constant barrages with little downtime.
Ability recharge bonus reduced from 25% to 15%
Royal Engineer Section
Royal Engineers are having their manpower costs slightly adjusted to better reflect their light combat role that greatly tapers off past the early-game due to its close-range nature.
Manpower cost reduced from 220 to 210
Reinforce cost reduced from 29 to 27
M3 Stuart Light Tank
The Stuart’s accuracy is being slightly increased.
Accuracy increased from 0.075/0.0475/0.035 to 0.01/0.05/0.04
Foot Guards Section
Foot Guards are having their close and mid-range effectiveness increased to allow the unit to cause a little bit more damage at range if they are forced to fight from cover.
SMG mid-range increased from 15 to 17.5
SMG accuracy increased from 0.64/0.34/0.15 to 0.71/0.45/0.15
M3 Grant Medium Tank

With the Grant being less capable as an all-rounder unit, we are now able to reduce the unit’s unlock cost to better reflect its more specialized role at brawling with opposing medium tanks with some Anti-Infantry firepower.
Unlock fuel cost reduced from 40 to 20
Operation Thunderclap
Plane arrival time sped up from 7 to 5
30cwt LRDG Truck
2 Pounder cost reduced from 60 to 30 munitions
SSB Commando Section
Retreating now interrupts Evasion
Directed Air Support

Directed Air Support has received changes to allow more targets to be designated and in quicker succession. We have also sped up the strafing runs to allow them to more reliably hit their target after the air strikes have been called
Time to acquire targets sped up from 3 to 2 seconds; allows 4 targets max to be designated
Strafing run flight arrival time sped up to 3 seconds
Canadian Shock Section
Canadian Mortar now gives a grenade warning to the opponent when fired
Land Mattress Team
Fuel cost increased from 40 to 50
Polish Recon Mission
Health per plane reduced from 3000 to 1500
Munition cost increased from 50 to 65
Sherman VC Firefly Tank Destroyer
The armor of the Firefly is being reduced to allow opposing medium tanks to threaten this unit once they have managed to close the gap.
Frontal armor reduced from 185 to 160
Armory
We have made changes to the Armory to reduce the power of Panzergrenadier heavy builds which have become a staple for the faction, getting high durability when multiple upgrades are stacked on them.
In return, we have created a new upgrade that allows the Afrikakorps to opt out of the medical truck in the Armory to create greater tech diversity.
New Armory Layout
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40883127/33bede511648a0290c37ae8f67f5473322dfe0d0.png"]
Veteran Squad Leaders
Moved to a tier 1 pick and fuel cost has been removed
Damage reduction removed
Bolstered Panzergrenadiers
Moved to a tier 2 pick and now has a 20 fuel cost added
Advanced Repair
Replaced with Improved Base Logistics
Allows the Light Support Kompanie to heal nearby infantry at 3.2 health per second
Allows the Panzer Armee Kommand to repair nearby vehicles at 6 health per second
Halftrack Deployment

The Panzerjäger call-in currently allows the Afrikakorps to respond to early light vehicles that is often used to support their own light vehicle shock timing. This gave the Afrikakorps too much tempo, allowing them to dictate the early-to-mid game by getting a mobile Anti-Tank unit without a build-time. Because of these reasons, we are removing it.
In return, we are allowing two additional call-ins, allowing the Afrikakorps to bring in more support style units to bolster their ranks.
250 with Panzerjäger call-in removed
Added 250 with Panzerpioneer call-in for 250 manpower
Added 250 with MG 34 Team call-in for 275 manpower
Panzergrenadier Squad

The Panzergrenadier was too effective when firing on the move with their basic rifles, resulting in the unit having a little too much firepower. When mixed with their Combined Arms bonus, it made this infantry unit too good at assaulting and chasing down opposing squads.
Standard rifle moving accuracy reduced from 0.75 to 0.6
2.5 Tonne Medical and Utility Trucks
Field Supplies range reduced to 15 to match medical aura
Field Supplies duration reduced from 60 to 45 seconds
Panzerjäger Squad
To help Panzerjägers against heavier vehicles, we have changed their ambush bonus to grant them increased weapon penetration instead of accuracy.
40% ambush accuracy bonus replaced with +40% penetration
Penetration bonus increased with Battlefield Espionage Ambush Training
Flakvierling Halftrack
The Flakvierling is having a minor reduction in manpower cost as it is losing significant power when firing units in cover.
Manpower cost reduced from 280 to 260
StuG III D Assault Gun

The StuG D is having its AOE increased and projectile arc lowered to allow this unit to better hit targets that are on the move. The unit’s shells can still be dodged, but it is now much more likely the squad will take a light amount of damage from each shell.
Projectile minimum elevation lowered from 20 to 10; allows for lower angle shots for slightly faster time on target.
Support Advance reload penalty reduced from 50% to 25%
Area of effect radius increased from 4 to 4.5
Cannone da 105/28
Veterancy 1: +15% scatter accuracy
Veterancy 2: +20% rate of fire, +50% rotation speed
Veterancy 3: 20% Damage Reduction, +15% range (barrage and auto), +20% recharge speed
Panzer III N Medium Tank - Short 75mm
Veterancy reworked
Veterancy 1: 20% rotation rate
Veterancy 2: 20% rate of fire, 25% weapon scatter
Veterancy 3: +80 health, +30% rate of fire
Veterancy 4: Unchanged
Guastatori Squad
Submachine Gun moving accuracy increased from 0.75 to 0.85
Kriegsmariner Squad
Manpower cost reduced from 275 to 260
Reinforce cost reduced from 32 to 30
StG 44 Package cost increased from 40 to 50
Walking Stuka Rocket Launcher
Veterancy 2 now provides the following: 20% rate of fire, 20% ability range
Veterancy 3 now provides the following: 20% recharge speed, 30% rate of fire, 20% weapon scatter accuracy
Butterfly Bomb Paradrop
The arm time of Butterfly Bombs is being reduced to accommodate the change to paradropping that allows these objects to be targeted whilst in the air.
Arm time per mine sped up from 7.5 to 3.5 seconds
Can now be fired at while paradropping down
Goliath Demolition Vehicle
To make Goliaths less capable at finding targets on their own, we have greatly reduced their vision.
Vision reduced from 35 to 15
Transfer Depots
We are increasing the amount of resources required for transfer as the ability was too efficient.
Munition cost to transfer increased from 80 to 100
Fuel cost to transfer increased from 40 to 50
Gameplay
Improve high polling rate mouse input handling. This improve FPS while mouse panning and should mitigate the amount of hitches or performance blips on high polling rate mouses
Updated breach requirements so it no longer works on fighting nest/position or tunnels
250 Halftrack, 251 Halftrack, and 6x6 Truck now unload transported units behind the vehicle instead of from the center, improving unit pathing and reducing deployment issues

Tuned several projectile crater values to reduce the amount of yellow cover they create by around 30 - 50%. This caused yellow cover to often spawn outside the craters that were being formed by various weapons
Vehicle flamethrowers now correctly damage units at height differentials
Flak 30 anti-aircraft fire no longer damages infantry underneath targeted aircraft
Fixed reverse-move commands occasionally being ignored immediately after unloading passengers
Additional Anti-Tank-gun squad members now properly follow formation assignments
A.I .
A.I. infantry will now avoid using standard grenade abilities against vehicles
Increased A.I. usage of dedicated anti-vehicle abilities
Towing
Vehicles towing abandoned team weapons now display an Unload ability alongside Drop
Improved towing position calculations to reduce trailer teleporting during pickup and movement
Fixed an issue where towing could occasionally fail to attach to a target weapon
Fixed Ranger Weapon Training Bazooka debuff not applying correctly against penetrated vehicles
Fixed Gallant Stand being usable on HMG nests and fighting positions when it should not be
Airborne Recon Loiter targeting indicators now accurately represent the vision area granted
M3 75mm AT Halftrack no longer continues its barrage ability if it gets interrupted by a conversion to a different halftrack type like the M16 Motor Carriage.
LG 40 now uses the correct voice-over lines
Borgward Rocket Barrage can now fire without requiring line of sight
Fixed an issue where Terror Battlegroup's Jericho Trumpet could leave a permanent reveal-camouflage radius
Siege Camp can no longer be cancelled incorrectly during construction
Fixed an issue where Siege Camp recharge bonuses were not being applied correctly
Into the Breach no longer affects retreating squads and can no longer target them
Siegebreakers Flame Halftrack no longer reorients unnecessarily while idle, allowing flamethrowers to operate independently
Sturmtiger rear accessories now correctly reflect critical engine damage states
Fixed Australian Light Infantry Section's Sharpshooter ability consuming munitions and entering cooldown when interrupted or cancelled
Slightly increased Engineer Tank Trap spacing to reduce instances of squads becoming stuck
Recovered LRDG Trucks now correctly respawn as LRDG Trucks
Fixed a rare issue where the SSB Sniper could remain stuck in a prone pose while moving
Fixed Bersaglieri Urra! status duration visuals to correctly match the active buff duration
Fixed an issue where the 250/9 Armored Half-track's Hit and Run ability could be manually reactivated
Fixed an issue where Panzerjäger squads using Plunder could fail to receive a Bazooka
Kriegsmarine Hardpoints now properly block conflicting upgrade queues to prevent upgrades from cancelling one another
Fixed an issue where the Kriegsmarine Hardpoint auto-reinforce upgrade granted functionality before the upgrade completed
Char B1 coaxial HMG now plays its firing animation correctly
Adjusted Sturmtiger accessories to prevent reload animation clipping
Fixed PIAT firing animations incorrectly using bolt-action motion
Adjusted Nissen Hut damage visuals to improve damaged metal appearance
North Africa rock assets now correctly block unit movement
Fixed unit stuttering while pivoting during combat.
Reduced accidental click-drag movement commands issued to vehicles
Improved network disconnect and lobby error messaging
Reduced cases where selection rings rendered over prone or suppressed infantry models
Fixed targeting reticles appearing beneath bridges
Loiter reticles now correctly display team colors
Removed the 'Being Repair' icon from vehicles being salvaged by infantry
Recon Plane abilities no longer trigger "Incoming Airstrike" warnings for opponents
Fixed a rare Italian Campaign soft-lock that could occur during naval movement on the enemy turn
Fixed a custom match startup issue that could occur when hosting with a saved two-player map and a party larger than two players
Fixed a Quick Match lobby issue that could leave the Start Match button disabled if a player disconnected before loading began
Localization
Community reported improvements to German, Korean, and Russian translations to improve context of translations
Gameplay
Certain rate-of-fire bonuses may not behave consistently across all units and abilities
Panzerjäger Kommand - Tank Buster's Anti-Tank Grenade Assault sometimes does not activate while under the effect of Concealment, or on vehicles while in cover
Some magazine-fed weapons may receive unintended reload-speed adjustments rather than fire-rate bonuses
Special Operations Battlegroup SSF Commandos vehicle prioritization may become disabled after weapon swaps despite remaining enabled in the UI
Tourelle upgrades may halt if the associated control point is temporarily lost
Some Visual Effects for flares may end before their reconnaissance vision expires
Royal Engineer Section - Squad cannot use the Flamethrower Breach even after picking up a Flammenwerfer 35
Ground Attack may deal less damage than intended against certain emplacements
Units may occasionally remain active despite displaying zero health, the UI is rounding incorrectly - the unit still has health
Team weapons will explode if crew gets reduced to 1 the same time it is towed
HMG teams may fail to complete retreat actions after leaving garrisoned structures
A.I.
Wehrmacht A.I. does not currently deploy or utilize the Nebelwerfer team weapon
A.I. units may pursue hidden enemies and fail to adjust their behavior appropriately when targets remain undiscovered
A.I. behavior involving certain support and non-combat vehicles may be suboptimal
Wehrmacht A.I. does not use Critical Location Siege Breaker Battlegroup ability
British Forces A.I. does not use No Man Left Behind Polish Calvary Battlegroup ability
Deutsches Afrikakorps Expert A.I. may gain access to rifle grenades before meeting unlock requirements
Enemy A.I. may repeatedly issue retreat commands when players enter HQ territory
A.I.-controlled British Forces do not currently field Churchill Crocodile tanks
A.I. forces do not collect munitions crates created by Supply Drop
Campaign
Investigating a rare case where progression may be blocked when Partisan hubs fail to unlock
Air Support trait sometimes does not work when unlocked through "specialization" upgrade on US Armored units
Player's base buildings may have incorrect ownership if you start the Capture Anzio mission with a US Special Forces/Devil's Brigade company
Final Stand
Flanking Maneuver perk does not describe that the side armor bonus is only half the rear armor bonus
Critical Location can't be cast on an emplacement or outpost more than once, and does not activate on concrete bunkers.
If a player closes out of the game at the end of the match hastily, the perks and match rewards may not track correctly.
If you encounter a unit stuck/staying in an out of bounds area, you may have to move your units further away from the enemy A.I. Units for them to enter the playable area.
Audio, Art, and Animation
Allied forces crewed MG42 has VO lines changed to Wehrmacht after using White Phosphorus rounds
Completing upgrades on fighting positions or bunkers says "research complete" instead of "upgrade complete"
Some unit animations may appear incorrect
UI & UX
ELO adjustments may be displayed incorrectly after matches
Discord stream shows black screen or “Stream is paused” when streaming Company of Heroes 3. We have an open ticket with Discord about this issue
UI_AddChild(...) causes a severe FPS drop/memory leak; mod creators may encounter performance degradation and increased memory usage when using this function
Matchmaking cancel button continues to show for a few seconds after a match is found but is no longer functional
Unable to move camera with middle mouse button while holding Shift key
Random Faction selection does not save and reverts back to previous selections after Quick Match
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40883127/a8c95fd9ad0097be2e44c3c942dd8659240e8890.jpg"]

Today’s Hot Fix addresses several gameplay issues. Thank you to everyone who has submitted feedback; you can continue reporting any additional issues by visiting the Relic Help Portal and submitting a new request.
Fixed an issue where the Flakvierling Halftrack was able to suppress units while moving
Fixed an issue where the Battlefield Espionage Battlegroup applied additional offensive bonuses to certain units that were camouflaged
Fixed an issue where the 251/16 Flammpanzerwagen got the 251 Medium Carrier's veterancy bonuses for planting Riegel mines at Veterancy 3
A.I. will no longer use the Skirmisher Package Rifle Grenades without the Skirmisher Package
Fixed an issue where the Sturmtiger was failing to destroy abandoned team weapons and emplacements at the point of impact as intended
Fixed an issue where Tungsten Rounds caused the Panzer III N's short 75mm to fire a direct-fire projectile
Fixed issue where Elite Forces - Crack Armor weapon swap can cause loss of tungsten core weapon on that vehicle

We are partially fixing a bug with the SSB Commandos that saw them get more bonuses than intended from camouflage, however, we are keeping their ambush bonuses higher than other ambush troops due to their low durability, high opportunity cost to make them strong, and the Battlegroup lacks a traditional strong late game.
Fixed an issue where the SSB Commandos would get a speed boost when attacking from camouflage at Veterancy 3
Fixed an issue where the unit got two First-Strike bonus modifiers
SSB Commando camouflage First-Strike modifiers increased from 25% damage and 40% accuracy to 40% damage and 75% accuracy (could previously reach +56.3% damage and +96% accuracy)

The team at Relic is constantly reviewing issues reported by the community and adjusting priorities to address the most frequently occurring issues. Thank you for all your submissions to help.relic.com. To see a comprehensive list of the issues we are currently tracking, please refer to the 2.4.0 Update Patch Notes.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40883127/8c9df6f7618758f4ea0aff5132493478ac53d290.jpg"]

Today’s Hot Fix addresses several issues related to Gameplay/A.I., UI/UX, and stability. Thank you to everyone who has submitted feedback; you can continue reporting any additional issues by visiting the Relic Help Portal and submitting a new request.
Performing weapon conversions/upgrades no longer rewards extra veterancy if the unit was under the influence of an experience modifier
A.I will no longer target structures or points with damaging abilities, such as capture points
Free French Battlegroup
Fixed an issue where Old Guard caused units to take more damage on retreat rather than less
Fixed a case where the Sturmtiger was dealing more damage than intended to non-squad entities like buildings
Fixed an issue with the British Forces Canadian Shock - Offensive Resupply not generating its pulse aura
Special Service Battlegroup
Lewes Bombs will no longer stick to friendly vehicles should they intercept the ability’s trajectory
Desert Raider tooltip now correctly shows that it is a passive ability, instead of Offensive/Timed Ability
Fixed a case where Combined Arms attack speed bonus on team weapons was overriding other bonus sources, such as from veterancy
Fixed an issue where the Espionage Battlegroup allowed both Disruption Operation and Transfer Depots to be simultaneously picked instead of the options being exclusive
Elite Forces Battlegroup
Fixed an issue where the Stuka Ace could keep firing its autocannons, even on death
Ace Squadron

The area of effect on the Ace Squadron was set incorrectly too high, causing the ability to deal massive overlapping damage to units in the middle of their target zone, and overall being too difficult to avoid
Autocannon area of effect radius reduced from 6 to 4
Skirmisher Package

Between the powerful grenade and high base performance, the early power this grants is far too efficient. This is enabling players to go for massive concentrations of Panzergrenadiers too easily, so we're immediately toning this down.
Upgrade cost increased from 60 to 75
Skirmisher Package for Panzergrenadiers no longer allows additional weapons to be picked up and the upgrade cannot be purchased or will cancel if weapons are already in the squad's inventory.
Panzergrenadier squads with the Skirmisher Package should now reinforce at the same rate as standard Panzergrenadiers when reinforcing outside the base
Fixed the 251 Flamethrower Halftrack visual effect shooting at a downward angle
Players who do not own Dare & Destroy, should now see it as an option in the Battlegroups menu, informing them that it is available to purchase
Fixed an issue where our Japanese players were crashing when loading into matches with cosmetics

The team at Relic is constantly reviewing issues reported by the community and adjusting priorities to address the most frequently occurring issues. Thank you for all your submissions to help.relic.com. To see a more comprehensive list of the issues we are currently tracking, please refer to the 2.4.0 Update Patch Notes.
Investigating an issue where rarely the SSB Sniper will stay in a prone position while moving, until the unit either stops completely, or holds before it returns to a normal walk state
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40883127/25b926bd512a096d4e6d9f8c6aa8430d7a7e4504.jpg"]

The 2.4.0 Update will be available for Company of Heroes 3 today at 10am PT and includes 4 all-new Battlegroups as part of the Dare & Destroy DLC, 4 new base army cosmetic sets, multiplayer balance changes, and several bug and gameplay fixes.

Many of the fixes and changes included in today’s update are thanks to your feedback. Please continue to share your feedback or ask the dev team questions here and report any issues to us at help.relic.com.
Employ robust defenses and stalling tactics to subdue enemy assaults and buy time for a breakout.
Form a defensive line with French Rifle Sections, concrete Bastions and Tourelle defenses, while Railway Artillery and the venerable Char B1 Heavy Tank force a rout.
Mobilize siegeworks and specialist units to break enemy fortifications and create an opening for the vanguard to exploit.

Test the enemy line with additional infantry weapons and Flame Halftracks. Once a breach has been detected, crack apart even the most stubborn defensive line with Siege Specialists and the iconic Sturmtiger Heavy Tank.
Deploy elite raiding forces to deny resources and harass the enemy where least expected.

Raiding vehicles, Commandos and Snipers will ambush and whittle enemy units down, before fading away into the dust. Scorched Earth tactics will drain the enemy of their vital resources and punish every undefended hole in their frontline.
Develop an advanced and experienced force of infantry, aircraft and ground vehicles to outpace the enemy.
Lead a core of veteran infantry and vehicles with the Command 8Rad Armored Car, dominate the battlefield with Ace Stuka Squadrons, and deliver the killing blow with the mighty Tiger Ace Heavy Tank.
Take on the monumental task of protecting these priceless works of art with the Combat Curators legendary cosmetic set - inspired by the Monuments Men
Blend in and strike when your enemies least expect it with the Bush Wacker legendary cosmetic set

notes.title: British Forces - Rainy Day in Hell

items.text: From the mud of the Italian front to squalls on the riviera your soldiers will be prepared to fight for another Rainy Day in Hell with this legendary cosmetic set
Includes pants
Spot your enemy, load up and hunt them down with the Jagdkatzen legendary cosmetic set
Added a new subtle sound effect when units gain Veterancy

In update 2.4.0, we're aiming to introduce changes to address issues with anti-air, infantry combat, and the late game. Additionally, we've made improvements to snipers, off-map abilities, and heavy machineguns. The US Forces Partisans and Afrikakorps Espionage Battlegroups have also received a host of changes meant to improve their viability.

We’ve heard you on the current systemic issues causing a reliance on massed-infantry (blobbing), and we agree. Players are currently incentivized to mass units together, and there are insufficient counters to respond. We’re working on tackling this incrementally, with a series of wider changes that affect the overall game starting in update 2.5.0. For now, in 2.4.0, we’re aiming to address more isolated issues that can contribute to massing-infantry — such as infantry stutter stepping, delays in cover, and scoped rifles granting moving vision.
Infantry Combat

We have done some clean-up to prevent unintended gameplay outcomes between units in and out of cover. We have also adjusted suppression recovery in light cover to make it easier for heavy machineguns to pin units.
Majority of rifle weapon ready-aim times adjusted to 0.375/0.875 to limit stutter-stepping and reduce the ability for all squad members to fire
Units in cover no longer have an additional firing delay when engaging enemies directly in front of them
Light cover suppression recovery modifier reduced from 2.5 to 1
Burst weapons, like machine guns, will reset their burst after 10 seconds when not in combat to prevent cases where the unit only fires a 1-2 second burst before cycling cooldown/reloads
Snipers

We have adjusted snipers to have some interaction with cover, reducing their fire rate against units in cover, while slightly speeding up rate of fire against units in the open. This allows a player to use cover to reduce how many casualties they take but still allows the sniper to slowly pick away at units in defensive positions.
Changes to cost, survivability, and capture speed were made to help improve their general performance and value.
Manpower reduced from 340 to 320
Ready aim times for snipers now scale with cover, resulting in longer acquisition and firing times:
+50% against units in light cover
+100% against units in heavy/garrison
Ready-aim time sped up from 1.75 to 1.625
Cooldown sped up from 6.75 to 6
Reload sped up from 6.75 to 6
Fog of War reveal duration increased from 3 to 6 after firing to allow for counter sniping
Sniper capture rate increased from 1 to 1.33
Target size reduced from 1.5 to 1.33
Repairs
We have adjusted the repair system to make combat repairs more difficult, requiring a full squad to get the maximum repair rate and units that are in-combat will repair slower.
Repairs now scale with the number of squad members that are alive
Example: An Engineer Squad with 4 members repairs at the maximum rate of 8; if the unit is reduced to 1 squad member, repair speed is reduced to 2
Repairs are 75% slower if the unit was recently involved in combat; ends after 10 seconds of being out of combat.
Directional-based Airstrikes and Off-maps
Direction reticules are now directed from end-to-end, rather than from the center
Does not affect Propaganda Leaflets from the Terror Battlegroup
Airdropped Incendiary Bombs – Breakthrough & Air and Sea Battlegroups

The current incendiary bombs act more like a standard bombing run, inflicting good damage on detonation with the fire damage lasting for a short period of time. To focus these strikes on area denial, we have increased the duration of the fire and adjusted the bomb’s initial explosion damage.
Fire lasts for 30 seconds dealing 10 burn damage every 1.25 seconds to infantry and structures
Bomb damage set to 80
Deals 70% less direct hit damage to infantry
Bomb penetration set to 500
Bomb area of effect penetration set to 35
Airborne and Breakthrough Battlegroups Smoke Bombs
Arrival time sped up from 3 to 1
Bomb drop range increased from 120 to 200
Anti-Air Changes
Mobile anti-air units are having their AA range increased, allowing them to lockdown a larger area.
Fixed an issue where planes would still drop their payload on death if they made it to the target zone while crashing
Anti-Air Stance range bonus increased from x3 to 3.25
Toggle off recharge from 30 to 15
+75% traverse speed when active
Entering AA mode now also issues a stop command to prevent weapon rotation
Off-Map Artillery, Mines, and Airstrikes

Certain strikes could be too powerful against slower, larger vehicles and rear armor hits from high damaging weapon could be devastating with little counterplay as no unit had to be risked to get behind these vehicles.
Mines have also had this change applied to them as they always penetrate enemy vehicles and do not care about directional facing.
No longer able to gain bonus damage against vehicles when hitting rear armor
Recon Loiters
Planes no longer provide additional vision around themselves. Vision is only provided within the ability radius
Heavy Machineguns
The role of the Heavy Machinegun (HMG) is to quickly suppress enemies that enter their arc. However, certain HMGs failed to achieve this goal.
To improve their performance, the base suppression values are being raised, while their time to pin remains lower than that of the HMG 42 and 50cal.
MG 34 suppression increased from 0.01 to 0.011
M1919 HMG suppression increased from 0.0144 to 0.015
Vickers HMG suppression increased from 0.0144 to 0.0175
Vickers, MG 34, and M1919 HMG suppression damage against suppressed targets reduced from 0.5 to 0.4
Marder III M, 75mm Halftrack, and Archer Tank Destroyer
The following changes improve visual clarity of when these ability trigger and makes it easier for the bonus to be gained when these units are set-up ahead of time, prior to an enemy advance.
First Strike/Stabilized shot set-up time lowered from 6 to 3
First Strike/Stabilized shot now displays a status decorator when counting down
Flamethrowers

We are reducing Flamethrower DPS when they are firing on the move to reduce how powerful flamethrowers are when charging and chasing enemy units. They will still automatically hit enemies in the AOE but deliver less DPS compared to if the unit was stationary.
The damage bonus against emplacements is to make their effectiveness equal against all defensive emplacement types, not just being strong against bunkers.
Handheld flamethrower moving burst reduced from 1 to 0.5
Vehicle flamethrowers - moving burst reduced from 1 to 0.75
Deals +150% extra damage against non-bunker emplacements
Scoped Rifle Packaged - Jager, Australian, and Infantry Section
The role of this change is to make it harder to spot the defender with mobile squads, forcing them to expend flares to spot enemies prior to an attack.
+7 vision is only granted when the unit is stationary for 3 seconds
White Phosphorous and White Phosphorous Barrages
Scott and Pack Howitzer munition cost increased from 25 to 30
Damage over time no longer stacks
Infantry/Mortar/Off-Map Flares - Does not affect SLD Flares
Flare vision radius reduced from 45 to 40
Infantry squad launched flare range increased from 40 to 45
Resource Caches
Deployment changed from double-click to click-drag
Detection
Royal Engineers and US Engineers now detect nearby stealth units when equipped with the Utility Package
Unit Paradrops
Recharge time standardized to 60 across the board - Paratroopers, Anti-Tank Gun, Fallschirmjager
Air Support Center

We have implemented a small cooldown between airstrikes. The goal is to reduce the number of off maps being dropped at once which could overload the opponent. We have also added an initial cooldown to limit how early air strikes can be requisitioned.
All attack runs start on a 60 second cooldown when the structure is complete

When an Air Support Center ability is deployed, all ASC abilities are placed on an immediate 10 second recharge time. Does not apply if the ability is already recharging and would take longer than 10 seconds to recharge
Riflemen Squad

Riflemen and Panzergrenadier Veterancy 1 damage increase abilities are gaining a small munitions cost. This will make spamming these abilities over the course of a long game have an impact on the player’s munition economy.
Pour it On 'Em now has a 15 munition cost
Recharge time reduced from 180 to 120
M4(105) Sherman Bulldozer
We are increasing the minimum damage the Dozer and Brummbar does to infantry, allowing them to deal more health damage on non-direct hits.
Area of effect far damage increased from 0.15 to 0.25
M8 Scott SPG
Experience requirements lowered from 1800/5400/10800 to 1500/4500/9000
Veterancy 1 bonus changed to 10% ability recharge
Veterancy 2 ability recharge reduced from 35% to 25%
M4A3E8 Sherman Easy Eight

Grants and E8s are having their main gun anti-infantry performance reduced to be in-line with other medium tank guns. This change is to allow anti-tank guns and infantry AT to better counter these vehicles and encourage the usage of dedicated anti-infantry tanks.
Area of effect damage reduced from 0.83/0.35/0.2 to 0.84/0.25/0.15
Scatter angle increased from 7 to 10
Distance scatter max increased from 4 to 6
Distance scatter offset from 0.33 to 0.25
Ranger Squad

We have made a few adjustments to allow Rangers to synergize with other builds and have less bleed on a player’s economy. However, we are toning back Cover to Cover significantly, removing the speed component that allowed the unit to quickly close with enemy, especially in late game scenarios where light cover was prevalent.
Reinforce cost reduced from 50 to 45
Cover to Cover no longer provides a speed bonus when leaving cover
Cover to Cover recharge sped up from 7 to 3 seconds
Can only be converted in the HQ sector
Is now trained from the HQ rather than the Barracks
Artillery Beacon
This change slightly increases the time it takes for the first shell to land.
Drop height increased from 350 to 450
Resistance Fighter Squad
We are giving Partisans a slight boost to their survivability and upgrade costs to encourage the anti-infantry variants of the unit.
The AT rifles had their anti-infantry damage further reduced as when combined with Disruption Fire, it allowed the unit to contest other infantry units too easily.
GRB cost reduced from 90 munitions to 80
SMG cost reduced from 50 munitions to 40
Health increased from 85 to 90
AT Rifles penalty against infantry increased from 25% to 60%
Saboteur Squad
The Saboteur Squad will now stay on the field longer, allowing more time and opportunity for the unit to be used for trap-laying, scouting, and the occasional anti-vehicle ambush.

Underground Detonation

Tunnel Medical Caches

Healing rate increased from 3.2 to 4.8
False Orders

Fixed an issue with False Orders debuff aura lasting only 45 of the 60 seconds
Updated reticule to display team color
Tunnels

Ambush Camouflage now triggers for all units in the selection group when the ability is toggled
HMG 42 Team
This change is meant to allow the MG 42 to better deter vehicles and combo with other units such as Grenadiers, vehicles or anti-tank guns.
White Phosphorous Rounds slow vehicles by 25% for 2 seconds on hit or deflection
White Phosphorous Rounds duration lowered from 60 to 45
Grenadier Squad

The Breakthrough Package for Grenadiers has very weak scaling, relying on the standard Grenadier veterancy for a hybrid assault unit. We have made a significant change, giving Grenadiers upgraded with the Breakthrough Package different veterancy bonuses focused on direct combat and survivability while still providing some utility support through the Panzerfaust.
Breakthrough Package
Veterancy 1: 10% harder to hit
Veterancy 2: 20% accuracy, 25% harder to hit
Veterancy 3: 20 health, 20% damage, +5 Panzerfaust range
Panzergrenadier Squad

Riflemen and Panzergrenadier Veterancy 1 damage increase abilities are gaining a small munitions cost to make spamming these abilities over the course of a long game have an impact on the player’s munition economy.
Automatic Fire now costs 15 munitions
Automatic Fire recharge time reduced from 180 to 120
Jager Squad

Jagers became very difficult to deal with as the game progressed, gaining substantial survivability bonuses on a long-range squad that did not need to close the distance and could scout positions with flares.

We are toning back some of the unit’s survivability, making the bonus lower, and arrive at Veterancy level 2, requiring Jagers to remain in cover to be most effective. The Reconnaissance Package’s cost has also been increased to reflect the buffs it has gained over several patches regarding its damage output.
Reconnaissance Package munitions cost increased from 50 to 65
Veterancy 1 harder to hit moved to Veterancy 2
Veterancy 2 rate of fire bonus moved to Veterancy 1
Veterancy 2 received accuracy reduced from 20% to 15%
Flak 30 Anti-aircraft Gun Team

Recent changes such as the removal of light cover on the crew have made the Flak 30 too vulnerable to both direct and indirect attacks that need to be positioned and set-up to function. We are improving the AA gun’s survivability and lowering the cost to enable suppression.
Health increased from 90 to 105
Suppressing Fire munition cost reduced from 25 to 15
Flakpanzer IV Wirbelwind
Veterancy 1 acceleration bonus changed to +20% rotation rate
Veterancy 3 rotation rate changed to +80 health
Marder III M Tank Destroyer

Speed increased from 4.6 to 4.8

StuG III G Assault Gun
Veterancy 3 +15% rotation rate changed to +20% weapon penetration
Panzer IV Command Tanks
Veterancy 1 bonus changed from 25% acceleration/deceleration to 25% rotation rate
Veterancy 2 35% ability recharge speed changed to +20% accuracy

Panzer IV Medium Tank – Wehrmacht only
Following the route of Wehrmacht’s advanced infantry, we are giving veteran Panzer IVs slightly increased performance to compensate for the unit’s lack of end game offensive upgrades.
Veterancy 1 and 2 accuracy and penetration bonuses increased from 20% to 25%
Stosstruppen Squad

Stosstruppen are being adjusted, weakening their Veterancy 1 ability in exchange for having improved veterancy stats as the unit levels up. Their Veterancy 1 bonus has also been adjusted to focus on damage rather than survivability.
Fixed an issue where Veterancy 2 did not provide the correct 20%
Veterancy 1 harder to hit moved to Veterancy 2
Veterancy 2 rate of fire bonus moved to Veterancy 1
Veterancy 3 Accuracy bonus increased from 20% to 25%
Range of all grenades increased from 20 to 25
Shock Assault now increases moving accuracy by 30%, provides suppression immunity, and breaks suppression for 20 seconds. Combat bonuses removed.
Sturmpanzer IV Brummbar
We are increasing the minimum damage the Dozer and Brummbar does to infantry, allowing them to deal more health damage on non-direct hits.
Area of effect far damage increased from 0.15 to 0.2
LG 40 Anti-tank Gun
Accuracy increased from 0.075/0.045/0.04 to 0.075/0.05/0.04625
Penetration reduced from 160/120/80 to 160/100/70

Panther Heavy Tank
The following change is meant to allow the Panther to be easier to access as in late game scenarios where manpower is a greater limiting factor than fuel.

Pantherturm

Can now gain veterancy

Veterancy 2: + 25% rate of fire and accuracy
Veterancy 3: +20% damage reduction +20% damage
Infantry Section

The following changes are meant to reduce how powerful the Recce Package. Other units will now need to be mixed in to provide vision, and the unit cannot immediately push team weapons with the artillery barrage before the opponent can react.
Recce Package no longer provides detection bonuses
Forward Observer Artillery Barrage must now be thrown at the target position, and artillery only begins to fire once the flare has landed; affects Gurkhas as well

The following change is to slightly increase the Stuart’s reliability against infantry and improve the unit’s veterancy scaling.

Distance scatter max reduced from 3.5 to 3
Veterancy 1 acceleration changed for +20% rotation rate
Veterancy 2 rotation rate bonus changed to +15% accuracy
Veterancy 3 accuracy bonus changed to +20% speed
M3 Grant Medium Tank

Grants and E8s are having their main gun anti-infantry performance reduced to be in-line with other medium tank guns. This change is to allow anti-tank guns and infantry AT to better counter these vehicles and encourage the usage of dedicated anti-infantry tanks.
The Grant is also having its base fuel cost increases to make additional tanks harder to field.

75mm area of effect distances adjusted from 1/2/3 to 0.25/0.75/4.5
Scatter angle increased from 7.5 to 10

Unlock cost reduced from 50 to 40 fuel
Matilda Heavy Tank

Centaur IV Medium Tank
The Centaur is having its area of effect distance increased to increase the chances of killing infantry models, rather than wounding them if the shell does not directly hit them.
Area of effect distance increased from 0.25/0.35/1.5 to 0.5/0.75/1.5

Damage bonus reduced from 20% to 15%
Attacking Spirit
Attacking Spirit has been adjusted, so the combat healing of the ability only happens on the trigger of the pulse, and the additional healing provided can now be interrupted by combat.
This should increase counterplay, allowing the opponent to keep units with Attacking Spirit in-combat or off capture points to prevent healing during combat.
Immediately heals 15 health on decapture when infantry enter the pulse
Heals 75 health over 45 seconds afterwards; healing is paused when in combat, but ability duration continues to tick down even when healing is paused.
Retains 2 CP cost
Logistical Supremacy Changes
Artillery Tripwire Flares and Reinforced Resource Caches moved up to the 1st tier of Logistical Supremacy
CMP 15cwt Supply Run moved to the 2nd tier of Logistical Supremacy

Australian Light Infantry

Australians can now repair buildings to better synergize with the defenses they can build and will be easier to gain veterancy with, matching other standard infantry squads. Moving accuracy on the Scoped Lee Enfield has been lowered, however, to make them less effective on the move.
Can now repair structures at a speed of 8 health per second
Experience requirements lowered from 1000/3000/6000 to 900/2700/5400
Scoped Rifle moving accuracy reduced from 75% to 50%

Fixed an issue with flare duration not extending to the intended 15 seconds
Carro, L6/40, Flakvierling Halftrack, DAK 8 rad

DAK combat light vehicles are receiving a change that allows them to gain health when they gain veterancy, allowing them additional survivability when used properly, but still vulnerable when they first arrive on the field or are rebuilt.
We want DAK to still be able to play heavy on light vehicles compared to the other factions, rather than the best option generally being massed infantry.

Panzerpioneer Squad

250 Light Carrier and 250/9 Halftrack

Veterancy 2 ability recharge replaced with +40 health

Range increased from 70 to 75
